name: Unraid
description: Self-hosted Unraid server: system stats, Docker containers, parity check, VMs, shares, alerts. Talks directly to the official Unraid GraphQL API (server version 7.0 or newer). Pure LAN — no cloud relay, no OAuth. Auth is a single API key created in the Unraid UI.
author: iappyx
aiPrompt: iappyx.plugin('unraid') talks directly to a self-hosted Unraid server (version 7.0+) over the LOCAL network via its official GraphQL API at `<host>/graphql`. Auth is a single x-api-key header — the key was created in the Unraid UI (Settings → Management Access → API Keys) and stored in secureStore by the plugin's settings page. The plugin is network-restricted to the user's trusted Wi-Fi by default (the server isn't reachable otherwise). All methods return Promises that resolve to {ok:true, …} or {ok:false, error:'…'} — never throw. KEY METHODS — isConfigured() → {ok, configured, host, hostname}. systemInfo() → {ok, hostname, uptime (ISO seconds), version (e.g. '7.0.0'), kernel, cpu:{brand, cores, threads, usage}, memory:{total, free, used, available}, temps:[{label, value}]} — usage is 0..100 percent. arrayInfo() → {ok, state ('STARTED'|'STOPPED'|'STARTED_NEW_CONFIG'|…), used, free, total (bytes), parities:[{id, name, status, temp, size}], disks:[{id, name, type:'Data', status, temp, fsSize, fsFree, fsUsed}], caches:[{id, name, status, temp, fsSize, fsFree, fsUsed}]}. containers() → {ok, containers:[{id, names:[string], image, state:'RUNNING'|'EXITED'|'PAUSED'|…, status (human:'Up 3 hours'), ports:[{ip, privatePort, publicPort, type}], autoStart}]}. containerStart({id}) / containerStop({id}) / containerRestart({id}) → {ok}. vms() → {ok, vms:[{id (uuid), name, state:'RUNNING'|'SHUTOFF'|'PAUSED', uptime}]}. vmStart / vmStop / vmForceStop → {ok}. parityCheck() → {ok, running:bool, progress:0..100, speed (MB/s), eta (seconds), correct:bool, errors:int, lastCheck:{date (ISO), durationSec, errors, status}}. parityStart({correct:false}) starts a check (correct=true tells Unraid to fix mismatches). parityCancel/Pause/Resume → {ok}. shares() → {ok, shares:[{name, free, used, size (bytes), allocator:'highwater'|'fillup'|'mostfree', cache:'no'|'yes'|'only'|'prefer', include:[disk], exclude:[disk]}]}. notifications() → {ok, notifications:[{id, title, subject, description, importance:'NORMAL'|'WARNING'|'ALERT', timestamp (ISO)}]}. ESCAPE HATCH — query({query:'<raw graphql>', variables:{}}) for anything not surfaced by the helpers (returns {ok, data} or {ok:false, error}). BEST WIDGETS — 'server status' (hostname + uptime + CPU/RAM bars + hottest disk temp), 'container grid' (pill per container, tap to start/stop), 'parity progress' (idle text or running bar+ETA), 'share storage' (per-share used/free bar). Polling cadence: status 5s, containers 30s, parity 5s when running else 60s. Container stats are cheap (state only); avoid per-container CPU/RAM stats in widgets unless the user explicitly asks.
